body:
New internal/games.Registry["mixforge"] row (mixforge.play, RecordingsEnabled) and 3 new GameOnlineHandler routes (POST/GET recordings, GET recordings/{id}) reusing the existing /api/v1/games/{game}/... machinery -- BLOB-in-SQLite storage (mixforge_recordings, mirrors nock_sounds' own precedent for MediaRecorder audio). No new guest-account bootstrap needed: ssoExchange already claims a first-touch, unscoped IDUNA identity for whichever game calls it first. SSO_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_HOSTS gained mixforge.okemily.com/iam.okemily.com. 4 new handler tests, full go test ./... clean. Live-verified against production post-restart: guest-register -> save -> list -> row confirmed in var/iduna.db via real curl calls. IDUNA@a372fb0.

⚓ ☃
title: MIXFORGE player identity + recorded-mix storage (S513)
